input.prompt:
ORIGINAL 2D CHARACTER SOURCE SHEET for "Mother Mycelium", fungal-city miniboss in a playful mobile tower-defense game. Pure flat/cartoon 2D illustration, chunky shapes, clean dark outlines, saturated magenta/cyan/lime palette, soft cel shading, high phone readability. NO 3D render, NO realistic materials, NO toy/figurine look.

Character identity: broad squat fungal queen rooted to cracked city pavement; large layered mushroom-cap crown, asymmetrical glowing spots, pale stem torso with expressive mischievous/menacing face, glowing mycelium core in chest/abdomen, four short root-tentacle lower limbs, two thicker mycelium arms ending in spore bulbs, dangling hyphae. Cute-weird rather than horror.

Create 5 isolated consistent poses on a warm off-white background with generous spacing:
1 dormant rooted / cap lowered,
2 awakening,
3 active idle hero pose,
4 spore-burst attack,
5 hit/stagger.
Same anatomy, same proportions, same camera in every pose. No text, no labels, no UI, no logo, no extra characters.
